what_is_measured: Test-retest reliability of f(mut)-f(WT) -- the per-sequence score the mutation search ranks by -- across D independent draws of the K shared decoding orders under protocol score_only/v2, as one-way random-effects ICC(1,1). No experimental data is involved. This is Monte-Carlo stability of the score against re-drawing its decoding orders and says NOTHING about biological validity: a backbone reaching ICC 0.99 buys no experimental validity.

decision_rule.rule: retain K=8 iff ICC >= 0.95 with F-interval lower bound >= 0.9 on >= 90% of backbones

descriptor_associations.status: EXPLORATORY — declared in advance as hypothesis-generating, not a finding
